title: Toy Store
html:
The main entrance of the toy store interior.

The Toy Store is a toy store themed interior that most commonly spawns on Filitrios.

> Rooms

  • Toy Store - The primary area of the interior featuring carpeted floors, several tables and shelves, etc. Scrap can primarily spawn on the tables and shelves or in Chests.
  • Toy Vault - A large door with a large disturbed mask on it and symbols below it. Typically spawns close to or loosely connected to the main entrance. The vault can be or will be opened after completing a Secondary Objective and reveal a chest behind it with a reward.
  • Mask Room - Either a room with masks on the wall above the Ball Pit or hallways with several masks on the wall, though they typically spawn together.
  • Chest Gauntlet - A room with several Trapped Chests lining either said of the walkway that lead to a single interactable Chest. Interacting with this chest will cause the Trapped Chests to start activating from the first chest to the hallway entrances. Note that some chests may spring open early and players must wait at the intersection before quickly choosing a safe path to run down.
  • Wooden Labyrinth - A wooden area in the Toy Store that is older, more decrepit, and maze-like in structure. Several Nutcracker statues are scattered around in it.
  • Web-Wire Room - A room covered in cobwebs. This is primarily for the Avoid the Wires objective.
  • Pink Apparatus - A room that is not guaranteed to spawn that has a face and a Pink Apparatus as the nose. It is conductive, is two-handed, weighs 31lbs, and is worth ▮110. After taking the Pink Apparatus, music will begin playing, the face will get angry, the eyes will begin to glow red, and a shotgun will replace the nose and fire forward. A Toy Face Jester will also be spawned about 30 seconds after the apparatus is pulled.
  • Apparatus - A regular apparatus can spawn on a wooden tile, typically connected to or in the Wooden Labyrinth.

> Interior Features

  • Chests - Chests can be interacted with and opened, sometimes containing scrap inside them. However, these can also be Trapped Chests.
  • Carousel - A carousel players can ride on.
  • Players can interact with some of the masks on the wall to reveal graffiti behind them.
  • Nutcracker statues will be present on the exterior of a moon that spawns the Toy Store interior.

> Hazards

  • Trapped Chests - Chests that jumpscare the player by springing out a mask attached to a coil after being opened, which is harmless. However, masks that spring out that are glowing red will shortly explode after the chest is opened and deal 65 damage to all nearby players.
  • Ball Pit - A bottomless ball pit. Any who jump inside will instantly die and cannot be recovered.
  • Tripwire Traps - A tripwire that triggers a shotgun. Any player coming into contact with the tripwire string will trigger it. All nearby players will take 99 damage and it will hurt or kill nearby entities. These can be disarmed by interacting with them. Note that these traps can spawn at fire exit doors.
  • "Welcome Home" Trap - A variant of the Tripwire Trap that only spawns in doorways with eight shotguns pointing down and one pointing through the doorway. If the trap is triggered, players can quickly interact with the trap weight on the side before it falls down to disable it. Another way to avoid taking damage from this trap is to sprint through it and run quickly to the left or right before the final shotgun can go off. Players hit by the trap will take 200 damage and it can hurt or kill entities.
  • Toy Face Jester - About 30 seconds after the Pink Apparatus is pulled, this variant of the Jester will spawn. It will almost immediately enter and exit its cranking state to begin pursuing players. However, it has a significantly reduced maximum speed.

> Secondary Objectives

The Toy Vault that holds the reward.

One of three unique objectives will randomly generate for players to complete for one of three valuable rewards that spawns in the chest inside the Toy Vault.

Kill the Key Keeper

If the Toy Vault has a symbol of a Nutcracker and key, players must find and kill the Key Wielding Nutcracker that almost immediately spawns in the interior upon landing. This is a variant of the Nutcracker with the only notable differences being the visuals. It will drop a Bloody shotgun, Bloody Ammo, and a Toy vault key on death.

Once the key is acquired, players can return to the Toy Vault, open the door, and open the chest for their reward.

Turn the Masks

If the Toy Vault has a symbol of a comedy and tragedy mask pointed to a direction, players must find a total of eight mask statues in the interior. They must be turned to face the respective listed direction depending on if they have a comedy or tragedy mask on them. These statues appear in sets of four and typically spawn in Toy Store sections of the interior as well as on staircases. If a statue's starting position is already facing the correct direction, it must be fully turned around back to that position to properly register for the objective.

After all eight statues are turned to face the correct direction, a sound effect will play and players can return to the Toy Vault to open the chest for their reward.

Avoid the Wires

If the Toy Vault has a symbol of a button, players must head to the Web-Wire Room to push the button. There will now be several Tripwire Traps in the room that are difficult to discern from the webs. Players must carefully navigate through to the other side of the room, typically on the right-hand side, and push the button.

After the button is pushed, a sound effect will play and players can carefully leave the Web-Wire Room and head back to the Toy Vault to open the chest for their reward.

The reward is randomized, but the chance for a more valuable reward is increased by how early in the day players complete the objective and is influenced by the vanilla luck system. The value of the reward is additionally increased by a difficulty multiplier, ranging from 0.6x to 1.4x, and a solo (singleplayer) multiplier of 1.17x. Kill the Key Keeper and Turn the Masks are both considered Medium difficulty with a reward multiplier of 1.15x. Avoid the Wires is considered Hard difficulty and has a reward multiplier of 1.4x. The base value and multipliers for objective rewards can be adjusted in the Wesleys Interior Tools config under the Secondary Objectives section.

> Event: The Cake

The Cake prior to starting the event.

The Cake can randomly spawn within the interior. It is a room with a large cake roughly in the center of the room that prompts players to eat it. If a player interacts with the cake, the walls will slide over all four sides of the room and trap all players inside. Music will begin playing, the room will begin spinning, and a head with two masks will spring out of the top of The Cake.

Five waves of shotguns starting from the second layer and ending on the first layer of The Cake will start appearing and firing. These deal 200 damage per hit and are angled to hit all players in front of them. There are specific patterns The Cake chooses from for these waves of shotguns, but which pattern is chosen is random.

Before the start of the third wave, two spinning blades will come out of The Cake. Coming into contact with the sharp end of the blade will deal 100 damage to players. Additionally, four knives that rotate around the edge of the arena will appear during the third wave that also deal 100 damage to players that come into contact with their sharp edge.

After all five waves, the walls will slide back open and players must immediately run out of any door and away from the room. The Cake will shortly explode after the fifth wave and rapidly deal 20 damage per hit to any players nearby. Players can safely return to the room after the explosion, but note that the knives are still present and still deal damage to players that walk into them.

The reward for the event is seven scrap that spawns where The Cake was. This seven scrap is randomly selected from the moon's scrap table. Note that this scrap only spawns if the player that initially interacted with The Cake survives until it explodes and that specific player is not teleported via the ship's vanilla teleporter. Additional modification to teleport a player through other means is generally fine.

> Trivia

  • The Cake existed prior to the Obscurity update and is now considered its interior event. The four knives that rotate around the edge of the arena also previously only spawned during Eclipsed weather.
  • A spooky version of the Toy Store created for Halloween can be enabled in the Magic Wesley Toy Store config.
